item.title: Bitcoin Drifts Below $78,000 as ETF Inflows and Institutional Custody Grow
item.summary: BTC/USD closed at $77,988.2565 at 17:00 UTC on August 26, down 1.48% over 24 hours, while Bitcoin Magazine reported $2.08 billion in U.S. spot ETF inflows over five sessions and BlackRock custody of 765,000 BTC.
